system.fault.note: Register dump over polled USB CDC + SOS blink. HardFault verified on Core.ST.L4.2 (projects/fault-test)

timer.tick.note: Verified on Core.ST.L4.2 — LED blink via ISR (projects/timer-ticker)

timer.pwm.note: TIM15 PWM → EXTI loopback verified on Core.ST.L4.2 (projects/timers-pwmg_u2)

timer.stepdir.note: DM320T + NEMA 11 over STEP/DIR at 3.3 V, 8 us pulses (projects/RealReeler, 2026-09-08)

timer.capture.note: TIM2 32-bit capture measuring TIM15 PWM period — 499995 us @ 2 Hz (projects/timers-pwmg_u2)

timer.wdog.note: 2s IWDG resets MCU after starved refresh — USB + PWM ramp test (projects/timers-pwmg_u2)

adc.trigger.note: Register path is generic (CFGR1 EXTSEL/EXTEN), but only the Core.ST.L0 trigger source constants are defined (LL_ADC_L0_TRG_*, RM0377 Table 58). Other families need a raw encoding from their own reference manual.

coregen.timer.note: Generates PAD_n_TIM/CH defines and core_pad_timer_info(); tested on adc-pwm example

power.stop.note: Two back-to-back 10 s stop_for with a 5 s IWDG running, no watchdog reset. Wake flag now cleared in RTC_SCR 0x5C (was RTC_TSDR 0x34, RM0394 §35.6.20); sleeps in watchdog-safe chunks. Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.L4.1 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle, all 8 pass, 0 watchdog resets across two 10 s stops).

power.standby.note: Standby wake plus woke_from_standby() clear (T6/T7); refuses a Standby longer than half the watchdog timeout (T5). PWR_SCR is 0x18, not 0x14 (RM0394 §5.4.7). Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.L4.1 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle, all 8 pass, 0 watchdog resets across two 10 s stops).

power.rtc_wake.note: LSI RTC wakeup from Stop and Standby; WUTF cleared in RTC_SCR, wake vector enabled under PRIMASK. Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.L4.1 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle, all 8 pass, 0 watchdog resets across two 10 s stops).

power.exti_wake.note: Pad-edge wake from Stop 1 was verified (projects/power-test); core_stop_until_on_change now waits for the edge itself and wakes to feed a running watchdog. Reworked 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.wkup_wake.note: core_standby_until_on_change(8, EDGE_FALLING) verified on Core.ST.L4.2 (projects/power-test); its wake-flag clear moved to PWR_SCR 0x18, and it now returns without sleeping while the watchdog runs. Fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.rtc_alarm.note: Alarm A at 0x40 on the L422's newer RTC (RM0394 §35); fired at 2980 ms for a 3 s alarm (T2). Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.L4.1 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle, all 8 pass, 0 watchdog resets across two 10 s stops).

power.backup.note: TAMP_BKPxR at 0x40003400 + 0x100 (RM0394 §36.6.8); write and read-back (T1). Bench-verified 2026-09-25 on Core.ST.L4.1 (tests/hw-sleep-cycle, all 8 pass, 0 watchdog resets across two 10 s stops).

security.rng.note: HSI48 + CCIPR mux. 6/6 tests pass: init, read, uniqueness, fill, error check, deinit/reinit (tests/val-backup-rng-alarm-u)

adv.comp.note: L422 has COMP1/COMP2; pins available on Core.ST.L4.2
